# CaloWet Air – HVAC Solutions Kenya
# https://calowetair.co.ke
# llms.txt — machine-readable site description for AI models

## About
CaloWet Air is a professional HVAC (Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning)
company based in Kenya. We are led by senior certified technicians with over a
decade of hands-on experience.

## Services
- HVAC Installation (split AC, cassette AC, VRF/VRV systems, refrigeration, heating)
- Product Sales (Daikin, LG, Samsung, Carrier, Midea, Bitzer equipment)
- Maintenance & Support (scheduled servicing, emergency repairs)
- Consultation (site survey, load calculation, energy efficiency advice)

## Coverage Regions
Nyanza, Western Kenya, Central Kenya, Rift Valley

## Target Customers
Homes & residences, hotels & hospitality, corporate offices, real estate developers
